questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was a horrible student accommodation. During my 4 month stay we experienced two huge water leaks and the landlords didn't really care to fix the situation so the leak kept happening. The accommodation has legal windows creating a very cold indoor climate, a perfect playground for cold because the carpets were wet from the leak. I has a lot of old in my room. I had to throw out multiple of my belongings because they were covered in mold. The smell inside was very damp. It was just a horrible experience.
